learning_objective: 🎯 [Students will understand the difference between Definite (The) and Indefinite (A/An) articles, and learn when NOT to use them.]
warm_up_hook: 📖 The words 'A', 'An', and 'The' are small but mighty! They tell us if we are talking about any general thing, or one exact, special thing. Let's master the art of Articles! 🎨

lesson_modules.teaching_content: We use 'A' and 'An' when talking about a general, singular countable noun. The trick is SOUND, not spelling! Use 'An' before a vowel SOUND (a, e, i, o, u) and 'A' before a consonant SOUND.
examples_or_templates: A car, A uniform (sounds like 'Yoo-niform', so we use 'A')
An apple, An hour (the 'h' is silent, so it starts with an 'o' sound)

lesson_modules.teaching_content: We use 'The' when we are talking about a SPECIFIC thing that the listener already knows about, or when there is only one of that thing in the world.
examples_or_templates: The sun, The moon, The Himalayas (unique things)
I saw a dog. The dog was barking. (Specific, because we already mentioned it)

lesson_modules.teaching_content: Sometimes we don't need any article at all! We usually drop the article before Proper Nouns (names of people/cities), Abstract Nouns (general ideas), and uncountable materials.
examples_or_templates: Material/Abstract: 'Gold is shiny.' / 'Honesty is the best policy.'

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ Choose the correct article: 'My uncle is ____ honest man.'
❓ Which sentence is perfectly correct?
options: The water is good for health.
A water is good for health.
An water is good for health.

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Fill in the blanks: 'I bought ___ umbrella and ___ raincoat today.'
subjective_practice.hint: Check the starting sound of 'umbrella' (vowel) and 'raincoat' (consonant).

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Why do we say 'An M.P.' even though 'M' is a consonant?
subjective_practice.hint: Say the letter 'M' out loud. Does it start with an 'em' (vowel) sound?

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Fill in the blank: 'Look at ____ stars in the sky!'
subjective_practice.hint: We are pointing to specific things that are unique to our universe.

activity_or_assignment.title: 📰 Newspaper Article Hunt
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Take a page of an old newspaper or magazine. Highlight the word 'A' in pink, 'An' in blue, and 'The' in green. Tally them up to see which article the writer used the most!

chapter_summary: ⭐ 'A' and 'An' are Indefinite Articles used for general, singular nouns based on vowel/consonant sounds.
⭐ 'The' is the Definite Article used for specific, unique, or already mentioned nouns.
⭐ Do not use articles before names of people, cities, or general uncountable nouns (like water or love).
